text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~, we played so much~.
That was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Splashing around in the sea, chatting with everyone a whole bunch...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it~!
We sure did a whole bunch of training~.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Working hard together with you, Trainer,
is another fun summer memory!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, don't you think I grew taller?
Didn't I grow like 50 cm?
I soaked up lots of sunshine, after all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know!
King-chaaan, let's see who's taller!
—And with that, the summer training camp came to an end.
